name: Existing five-question development benchmark
label_status: Provisional assistant-authored relevance judgments from local chunk text; not independently reviewed or guaranteed exhaustive. Recall measures coverage of these labels.

questions.question: What caused the Thirty Years' War?
questions.rationale: Religious/imperial tensions and immediate Bohemian triggers.

questions.question: How did the Thirty Years' War begin?
questions.rationale: Bohemian revolt, religious rights and Defenestration.

questions.question: Why did France enter the Thirty Years' War?
questions.rationale: Habsburg rivalry and intervention following Nördlingen.

questions.question: How did the Thirty Years' War end?
questions.rationale: Military pressure, Westphalian treaties and settlement terms.

questions.question: What were the human costs of the Thirty Years' War?
questions.rationale: Deaths, disease, famine and population losses.
